diagnostic.engine_source_scope: historical frozen native search source; not current main
diagnostic.bootstrap_unit: position mean paired completed-depth delta across two ABBA repeats
diagnostic.node_limit_overshoot_policy: Record every actual count and max(0,nodes-20000); no equality requirement, threshold, row exclusion, or retry based on observed results.
diagnostic.interpretation: Fixed requested-node development work observations only. Groups use one shared parent hard budget; actual nodes may overshoot. Under-budget rows are retained without inferring their reason. Completed depth and legal PV do not establish strength or timing. 4T and 8T remain separate. Root alpha_gap_max totals sum per-go maxima.

manifest.schedule: per-position ABBA; fresh process every slot

pv_validation.interpretation: Same-rules legal-PV check; not an independent oracle or mate-score proof.

interpretation: Negative completed-depth-per-requested-node observations at pinned historical source; no current-main timing or playing-strength inference. Both counts retain default-off status. All rows preserved; no retry or budget selection.
